Change-Id: I8c2114e538bb417deff8c3f9f107758c089227dc

#### What type of PR is this?

/kind feature

Fixes #112958 

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Adds health check SLI metrics to KCM. This is behind a feature gate. 

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
If `ComponentSLIs` feature gate is enabled, then `/metrics/slis` becomes available on kube-controller-manager, allowing you to scrape health check metrics.
```

#### Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.:

```docs
- [KEP]: https://kep.k8s.io/3466
```
